If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
//_comment_speed: HARDENED TIMING: Hardcode period to 11.64ns to natively support 24x master crystal multiplier (85.91 MHz)
//: SYNTH_STRATEGY - Restores the stable balanced logic restructuring formula to keep sequential steering paths clean and routable at high speeds.

SYNTH_BUFFERING - Forces Yosys to insert explicit cell buffers on high-fanout data and clock paths during elaboration. This breaks up complex multi-pin logic networks and permanently prevents TritonCTS from throwing memory segmentation faults during the clock tree synthesis pass.
SYNTH_SIZING - Enables aggressive pre-placement cell sizing to scale up internal logic gates to high-performance variations early.
SYNTH_HIER_PASS - Directs Yosys to perform synthesis hierarchically, locking down local submodule ports before physical cell mapping.
SYNTH_FLATTEN - Disable global flattening to preserve submodule boundaries for physical macro bounding and hierarchical power grid connection

SYNTH_PARAMETERS - Passes top-level elaboration flags to Yosys to explicitly preserve the hierarchical structural boundaries of internal submodules like clock_synchronizer during physical gate mapping.
MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT - Clamps internal signal fanout to 4 targets, forcing the tool to clone sluggish data lines and restore crisp transitions.
PL_REGIONS - Binds the entire unflattened u_c061618g2 macro logic block inside a strict physical coordinate bounding box on the Tiny Tapeout wrapper grid without needing a hard GDS database.
FP_CORE_UTIL - Force LibreLane to generate a much larger dynamic box for our 3% cell logic by lowering core utilization
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
RUN_POST_GPL_DESIGN_REPAIR - Bypass LibreLane crash by forcing automatic hold-buffer insertion after global placement
RUN_POST_GRT_RESIZER_TIMING - Force a final round of precise hold-buffer patching after physical wire routing lines are drawn
RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR - Force physical cell legalisation and track repair after global routing to resolve severe hold violations
CELL_PAD - Increase cell padding to force the tool to leave empty space around every single logic gate
RUN_POST_GRT - Direct the global router to optimize timing routes with maximum iterations
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
GLB_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS - Enforces a deep global routing timing pass to restructure logic networks across module ports right before detailed routing.
PL_RESIZER_DESIGN_OPTIMIZATIONS - Grants the local resizer permission to insert high-drive tap buffers along setup-violating filter chains.
PL_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS - Runs critical slack path resizing directly within the global placement iteration window.
PL_RESIZER_HOLD_MAX_BUFFER_PERCENT - Keeps your existing 100% freedom allocation active for fixing hold timing violations.
PL_RESIZE_BUFFER_PERCENTAGE - Allocates 40% extra optimization budget to allow OpenROAD to upsize slow gates to high-drive variants along your 229 MHz critical paths.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
